violations.text: The hand-washing sink near the cold sandwich unit was lacking paper towels. Napkins were placed on nearby shelf until paper towels arrive. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026

The handwashing sink near the mop room area was not in good repair, pulling away from the wall leaving a gap with ragged edges of old caulk. The seal along both sides of the splash guards is also in poor repair, with pieces missing, resulting in gaps filled with debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2026

The dumpster area was unclean, with bags of trash on the ground, torn open and spilling out, and an accumulation of trash & debris. Dumpster area must be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/24/2026
Beverage debris observed in hand sink in front service area. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/15/2025
